results.rationale: Consistency: The glass remains centrally placed with the same tall cylindrical form, wooden setting and overall lighting, but the tabletop grain is visibly retextured. Pellet and liquid changes are excluded. Instruction: White round pellets have appeared both among the ice and at the bottom of the original glass. The expected result is calcium chloride pellets added to this ice water at the specified five-minute stage; the addition is visible, but the timing is not established. The large ice pieces retain their original shapes and extent, so the expected melting is not visibly realized, a clear conflict. Quality, judged from this edit alone: Glass structure, perspective and wooden surface are coherent; the lower pellet cluster has slightly overly crisp, pasted-looking boundaries, a minor integration flaw.
